item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description:
Find the error text or symptom in the table for the step you are on, then apply the fix. Add --debug to any command for verbose HTTP logging.

Setup and authentication

Error or symptom Cause Fix
401 or Unauthorized Token missing, wrong, or not an org admin of the org it acts on. Set CIRCLECI_SOURCE_TOKEN and CIRCLECI_DEST_TOKEN. Each token's user must be an org admin of its org. Run circleci-migrate doctor.
Requests go to circleci.com but you run CircleCI Server Default host. Pass --host https://circleci.example.com, or set CIRCLECI_CLI_HOST.
Preflight fails: GitHub token required An OAuth project with no captured App pipeline definition needs a repo ID, which only the GitHub API returns. Set GITHUB_TOKEN (repo read) or pass --github-token, then re-run. Not needed with --skip-projects.
--dest-org-id rejected You passed a slug. Pass the destination org UUID from Organization Settings > Overview.
Prompts hang in CI No terminal. Add --no-input. It is implied when stdin is not a terminal.

Export

Error or symptom Cause Fix
A repo is missing from the manifest The repo was never set up as a CircleCI project. For gh/ orgs, add --follow-all --github-token "$GITHUB_TOKEN" to export. Archived repos are skipped.
Orbs or runner classes are missing The namespace was not given. Pass --orb-namespace and --runner-namespace. There is no automatic lookup.

Sync

Error or symptom Cause Fix
sync hit the source org No org.to in the mapping, so the destination defaults to the source. Pass --mapping with org.to set. See Mapping.
Dry run shows everything as manual No secrets bundle given. Expected on a first dry run. Move values with secrets transfer, or pass --secrets.
--apply fails on project creation (App destination) The repo is not connected to the destination CircleCI GitHub App. Connect the repo in the destination org's GitHub App settings and re-run. The re-run creates the missing definition and trigger.
Pipeline definition external_id is wrong Repos moved GitHub org, so the numeric repo IDs changed. Add --github-token and --dest-github-org, or a github_org mapping entry.
Definition is manual: "already exists ... but differs" A same-named definition has a different provider, repo ID or config path. Align or delete it in the destination and re-run. sync never modifies it.
sync exits non-zero after a pipeline definition or trigger [error] An API read or write failed for that project. The rest of the run still happened. Fix the cause (access, a transient failure) and re-run sync --apply. Existing items report exists. manual items do not fail the exit code.
sync --apply --yes exits non-zero after "enabling builds" At least one trigger failed to enable. Fix it and re-run sync --apply --yes --enable-existing-triggers.
Builds do not start after apply (OAuth destination) The project is not followed, or the webhook is not installed on GitHub. Follow the project in the destination and confirm the GitHub webhook.
A project is missing from the plan The destination cannot follow it yet. Check GitHub access and onboarding for that repo.
manual on a project's env vars or context values Secret values have not moved yet. Run secrets transfer. Use --missing-secrets placeholder to create the names now.
CIAM roles or groups did not fully apply Per-project grants and users not in the destination cannot be automated. Check migration-report.md. Add the user to the destination org and re-run. --skip-ciam leaves roles alone.
Environment hierarchies are manual They use a private API that a personal token may be refused. Create environments under Deploys > Environments and hierarchies under Deploys > Environment hierarchies.
A user sees an empty Projects page in the new org They have not authorized CircleCI with GitHub for the new org. Have them click Authorize and then Refresh permissions. Confirm the repos are connected to the App installation.

Context restrictions

Error or symptom Cause Fix
Project restriction is manual No destination project of that name exists yet. Run sync --apply --skip-pipelines to create the projects, add a projects mapping entry if the name differs, then re-run sync --apply.
Group restriction is manual sync matches groups by name, and no group of that name exists in the destination. Create the group, then re-run sync --apply. Or recreate the restriction in the destination UI.

Secrets transfer

Error or symptom Cause Fix
the project has no SSH key A gh/ or bb/ source project has neither a GitHub App pipeline definition nor a checkout key. Add a deploy key or user key under Project Settings > SSH Keys > Checkout SSH keys, or pass --host-project with a project that qualifies. Run the transfer before uninstalling the App.
Deploy keys are disabled by a GitHub policy An org or enterprise rule blocks deploy keys. Add a user key instead, or transfer while the GitHub App is still installed.
N source project(s) are paused (drop-all-build-requests=true) The source was paused by cutover --pause-source. Run the transfer first, or restore with cutover --undo --apply and re-run.
no destination project could be resolved A source project has no same-named destination project and no mapping entry. Create it with sync --apply --skip-pipelines, or add a projects entry, then re-run. Add --skip-contexts if contexts already went through.
SKIP ... dest project unknown in the plan Same cause. Same fix.
unauthorized, or WARN: blocking restrictions A project or expression restriction on a context blocks the host project. Re-run with --remove-restrictions.
Permission denied, or the pipeline is skipped allow_api_trigger_with_config is off in the source org. Add --enable-trigger, or enable it in Organization Settings > Advanced.
Project variables arrived empty An older CLI version. Upgrade circleci-migrate and re-run.
Destination context not created The destination token is not an org admin token, or the org does not exist. Use an admin token for the destination.

Secrets capture

Error or symptom Cause Fix
api-trigger-with-config disabled The org setting is off. Add --enable-trigger. It is restored afterwards.
Capture stops without triggering anything A non-interactive capture of everything fails closed. Scope it with --context or --project, or pass --yes to allow it.
Values missing for restricted contexts Restricted contexts are skipped by default. Add --remove-restrictions, or use sync --missing-secrets placeholder.

Cutover

Error or symptom Cause Fix
--enable-dest reports manual for a project The trigger match is ambiguous, or the manifest shows the project paused or not followed. Enable that trigger by hand in Project Settings > Triggers. Run sync --apply first so triggers exist.
--undo fails: state file missing or for another org Wrong --state path or the file was deleted. Point --state at the right file. Without it there is nothing to restore.
--undo only restores a flag The GitHub App was already uninstalled from the source. Expected. Pause the source before you uninstall next time.
Both orgs build sync --yes enabled the destination while the source was live. Pause the source with cutover --pause-source --apply.

Validate

Error or symptom Cause Fix
migration-secrets shows as missing The context exists only to run the transfer. Add --dest-token-context migration-secrets, or --ignore-context <name>.
Runner or orb section is skipped No destination namespace given. Pass --dest-runner-namespace and --dest-orb-namespace.
Exit 1 with missing items The destination lacks something the source has. Fix each item and re-run. manual items do not fail the exit code.

Orbs and runners

Error or symptom Cause Fix
Orbs are manual and sync does not republish The destination namespace has the same name as the source. A namespace cannot exist in two orgs. Ask CircleCI support to move the namespace to the destination org. Orbs move with it.
Runner class returns 409 or is manual: "attributed to another org" A class keeps the org it was created under, even after a namespace move. Delete the source copies, re-run sync, create new tokens and re-register agents.
Configs reference old orb names A different destination namespace was used. Rewrite each old/orb to new/orb from the notice that sync printed.

Terraform

Error or symptom Cause Fix
terraform apply fails on project settings Advanced settings are not supported for OAuth (gh/) orgs. Regenerate with --dest-org-type oauth. See Terraform.
sync overwrites Terraform-managed resources Both tools manage them. Run sync --skip-terraform-managed, or --only org-settings,ciam,extras.

item.title: Flags
item.description:
Every flag of every command, one line each. --help works on every command. The generated CLI reference has the full help text and examples. -o is short for --output and -y is short for --yes.

Global flags

These work on every command.

  • --debug — print every HTTP request and response (off).
  • --host — CircleCI host URL for CircleCI Server; also CIRCLECI_CLI_HOST, CIRCLECI_HOST, CIRCLE_URL (https://circleci.com).
  • --source-token — API token for the source org; also CIRCLECI_SOURCE_TOKEN.
  • --dest-token — API token for the destination org; also CIRCLECI_DEST_TOKEN.
  • --token — fallback token for both orgs; also CIRCLECI_CLI_TOKEN or CIRCLE_TOKEN.

doctor

Read-only preflight checks. Give --source-org, --dest-org, or both.

  • --source-org — run source-side checks: token, reachability, API-trigger flag, project discovery.
  • --dest-org — run destination-side checks: token, reachability, cross-type warning, GitHub token.
  • --github-token — GitHub token (repo read) to check; falls back to $GITHUB_TOKEN.
  • --dest-github-org — destination GitHub owner when repos moved; triggers the GitHub-token check.

export

Reads the source org into manifest.json and migration-report.md. Read-only.

  • --source-org — source org slug, such as gh/acme (required).
  • --dest-org — destination slug; changes nothing in the export but adds the cross-type checklist to the report for gh/ to circleci/.
  • --output — manifest path (manifest.json).
  • --report — audit report path (migration-report.md).
  • --project — export only this project slug; repeat for several (all projects).
  • --skip-contexts — do not export contexts (off).
  • --skip-projects — do not export projects (off).
  • --skip-extras — do not export checkout keys, webhooks or schedules (off).
  • --orb-namespace — capture every published orb and stable version in this namespace (off).
  • --runner-namespace — capture runner resource classes from this namespace (off).
  • --follow-all — follow every GitHub repo not yet set up as a project; gh/ orgs only; needs a GitHub token (off).
  • --github-token — GitHub token for --follow-all; falls back to $GITHUB_TOKEN.
  • --include-usage — also download a usage report CSV as a local record; it does not transfer (off).
  • --usage-start — usage window start, RFC 3339 (30 days ago).
  • --usage-end — usage window end, RFC 3339 (now); the window is at most 31 days.
  • --usage-timeout — how long to wait for the usage export job (10m).
  • --skip-preflight — skip the startup checks (off).
  • --json — print a JSON summary to stdout (off).

mapping generate

Writes mapping.json from a manifest.

  • --manifest — manifest path (required).
  • --dest-org — destination org slug (required).
  • --output — mapping file path (mapping.json next to the manifest).

secrets transfer

Moves secret values from source to destination inside a source-org pipeline. Dry run unless --apply.

  • --manifest — manifest path (required).
  • --dest-org-id — destination org UUID.
  • --dest-org — destination org slug; resolved to the UUID for you.
  • --dest-token-context — source-org context that holds the destination token.
  • --dest-token-env-var — variable name inside that context (CIRCLECI_DEST_TOKEN).
  • --dest-host — destination host URL for Server installs (https://circleci.com).
  • --mapping — mapping.json for project and context name overrides.
  • --context — transfer only this context; repeatable (all contexts with variables).
  • --include-project-vars — also move project env vars (off).
  • --include-ssh-keys — also move additional project SSH keys (off).
  • --skip-contexts — run only the per-project pipelines; needs one of the two flags above (off).
  • --remove-restrictions — lift project and expression restrictions for the run, then restore them (off).
  • --enable-trigger — turn on api-trigger-with-config for the run and restore it afterwards (off).
  • --host-project — source project that runs the context pipeline (picked for you).
  • --branch — branch to check out (each project's default branch, else main).
  • --poll-timeout — how long to wait for the pipeline (30m).
  • --apply — run the transfer (dry run).

secrets capture

Captures secret values into a local bundle. Interactive on a terminal when --manifest is omitted.

  • --manifest — manifest path (prompted when omitted).
  • --output — bundle path (secrets.json).
  • --context — capture only this context; repeatable (all in the manifest).
  • --project — capture only this project; repeatable (all in the manifest).
  • --host-project — project that runs the context extraction (prompted).
  • --branch — branch to check out (main).
  • --encrypt — encrypt the artifact with age (on).
  • --no-encrypt — produce a plaintext artifact; not recommended (off).
  • --generate-key — create an age keypair for this run (on when encrypting with no key given).
  • --ssh-public-key — public key or age recipients file to encrypt to.
  • --ssh-private-key — private key or age identity used to decrypt locally (~/.ssh/id_ed25519 if present).
  • --artifact-retention-days — set artifact retention before the run; 1 is the minimum and is not restored (leave unchanged).
  • --storage — where the bundle goes: artifact, s3 or both (artifact).
  • --s3-bucket — S3 bucket; required for s3 and both.
  • --s3-prefix — S3 key prefix (none).
  • --ssh-keys — also capture additional SSH keys; --ssh-keys=false skips them (on).
  • --skip-restricted-contexts — skip contexts with restrictions and warn (on).
  • --remove-restrictions — lift context restrictions for the run, then restore them (off).
  • --enable-trigger — turn on allow_api_trigger_with_config for the run and restore it (auto-detected).
  • --yes — allow an unattended capture of everything (off).
  • --no-input — disable prompts; error if a value is missing (on without a terminal).
  • --poll-timeout — how long to wait for each pipeline (10m; 0 waits forever).

secrets decrypt

Decrypts an age-encrypted bundle.

  • --identity-file — SSH private key or age identity to decrypt with (required).
  • --output — decrypted bundle path (secrets.json).

secrets extract

Used inside the capture pipeline; you rarely run it by hand.

  • --manifest — manifest path (required).
  • --context — context to extract; not with --project.
  • --project — project to extract; not with --context.
  • --output — bundle path to write or append (secrets.json).
  • --encrypt — write <output>.age; needs a recipient (off).
  • --recipient — age or SSH public key string.
  • --recipient-file — SSH public key or age recipients file.
  • --strict — fail if an expected variable is missing (off).

secrets merge

Merges partial bundles from several extract jobs.

  • --output — merged bundle path (secrets.json).
  • --encrypt — write <output>.age; needs a recipient (off).
  • --recipient — age or SSH public key string.
  • --recipient-file — SSH public key or age recipients file.

sync

Replays a manifest into the destination org. Dry run unless --apply.

  • --manifest — manifest path (required).
  • --mapping — mapping.json; org.to is required to leave the source org.
  • --secrets — secrets bundle path (secrets.json, skipped if absent).
  • --missing-secrets — variables with no value: skip or placeholder (skip).
  • --apply — write changes (dry run).
  • --yes — with --apply, enable builds without asking (off).
  • --enable-existing-triggers — also enable triggers that already exist disabled (off).
  • --skip-org-settings — skip org-level settings (off).
  • --skip-contexts — skip contexts (off).
  • --skip-projects — skip projects (off).
  • --skip-pipelines — create App projects with no definitions or triggers (off).
  • --skip-extras — skip checkout keys, SSH keys, webhooks and schedules (off).
  • --skip-runner — skip runner resource classes (off).
  • --skip-ciam — skip roles and groups; standalone orgs only (off).
  • --skip-orb — skip orbs (off).
  • --skip-preflight — skip the startup checks (off).
  • --skip-terraform-managed — skip sections Terraform manages: contexts, projects, runner classes (off).
  • --only — sync only these sections: org-settings, contexts, projects, runner, ciam, extras, orb.
  • --dest-orb-namespace — republish orbs into this namespace.
  • --dest-runner-namespace — recreate runner classes in this namespace.
  • --dest-github-org — destination GitHub owner when repos moved; needs a GitHub token.
  • --github-token — GitHub token (repo read) for repo IDs; falls back to $GITHUB_TOKEN.
  • --webhook-secrets-out — with --apply, write new webhook secrets and URLs here, mode 0600.
  • --create-project-tokens — with --apply, recreate project API tokens as new values (off).
  • --include-danger-flags — also write drop_all_build_requests and require_context_group_restriction (off).
  • --json — print a JSON summary to stdout (off).

cutover

Switches builds from source to destination. Dry run unless --apply.

  • --manifest — manifest path (required unless --undo).
  • --mapping — mapping file; org.to is required with --enable-dest.
  • --pause-source — pause the source: set drop-all-build-requests and disable enabled App triggers (off).
  • --pause-org — also pause the whole source org; use with --pause-source (off).
  • --enable-dest — enable destination triggers whose source trigger was enabled (off).
  • --undo — restore everything recorded in the state file (off).
  • --state — state file path, mode 0600 (cutover-state.json).
  • --apply — make the changes (dry run).

validate

Compares source and destination. Exit 1 means something is missing.

  • --source-org — source org slug (required).
  • --dest-org — destination org slug (required).
  • --mapping — the same mapping.json you gave sync.
  • --dest-token-context — leave this transfer-token context out of the comparison.
  • --ignore-context — leave this context out; repeatable.
  • --dest-runner-namespace — compare runner classes in this namespace (section skipped).
  • --dest-orb-namespace — compare orbs in this namespace (section skipped).
  • --no-input — fail on a missing flag instead of prompting (on without a terminal).
  • --json — print a JSON result to stdout (off).

migrate

Export, sync and validate in one command. Run with no flags on a terminal for the guided walkthrough.

It takes these flags with the same meaning as above: from export, --orb-namespace, --runner-namespace, --follow-all, --github-token, --skip-contexts, --skip-projects, --skip-extras, --skip-preflight and --json. From sync, --mapping, --secrets, --missing-secrets, --apply, --yes, --enable-existing-triggers, --skip-org-settings, --skip-pipelines, --skip-runner, --skip-ciam, --skip-orb, --dest-orb-namespace, --dest-runner-namespace, --dest-github-org, --webhook-secrets-out, --create-project-tokens and --include-danger-flags. These are specific to migrate:

  • --source-org — source org slug (prompted).
  • --dest-org — destination org slug (prompted).
  • --output — save the manifest here (kept in memory).
  • --report — save the audit report here (not written).
  • --transfer-secrets — after sync, run the in-pipeline secrets transfer; not with --secrets (off).
  • --dest-token-context — context holding the destination token; required with --transfer-secrets.
  • --include-project-vars — with --transfer-secrets, also move project env vars (off).
  • --include-ssh-keys — with --transfer-secrets, also move additional SSH keys (off).
  • --remove-restrictions — with --transfer-secrets, lift context restrictions for the run (off).
  • --host-project — with --transfer-secrets, project that runs the context pipeline (first project).
  • --preflight-only — run the checks and exit (off).
  • --skip-validate — skip the parity check that runs after a successful --apply (off).
  • --no-input — disable prompts (on without a terminal).

terraform generate

Writes Terraform files from a manifest. See Terraform output.

  • --manifest — manifest path (manifest.json).
  • --dest-org-id — destination org UUID (required).
  • --dest-org-type — oauth or standalone (inferred from the source slug).
  • --out — output directory (./terraform).
  • --mapping — mapping.json for slug and project ID remapping.
  • --secrets — secrets bundle; writes plaintext to secrets.auto.tfvars.json.
  • --placeholders — write REPLACE_ME values and a fill-in workbook (off).
  • --dest-runner-namespace — destination runner namespace (the source namespace).
  • --import-existing — emit import blocks for resources that already exist (off).
  • --existing — sync --json output file that supplies the IDs; required with --import-existing.

orb inline

Rewrites a config so its orbs are inlined.

  • --config — .circleci/config.yml to rewrite (required).
  • --namespace — inline only orbs in this namespace (all).
  • --output — output path (stdout).

item.title: Terraform output
item.description:
terraform generate turns an exported manifest into Terraform files for the official CircleCI-Public/circleci provider (~> 0.3). Use it when the destination org should end up in Terraform state. For a one-shot migration, sync is simpler.

Terraform manages the resource shells: contexts, projects, variables, webhooks, runner classes, and pipelines and triggers. The CLI still handles everything the provider cannot. The generated GAPS.md lists each remaining step with its exact command.

flowchart LR
E[export] --> G[terraform generate]
G --> T[terraform apply]
T --> S[sync --skip-terraform-managed]
S --> V[validate]

Generate 

circleci-migrate terraform generate \
 --manifest manifest.json \
 --dest-org-id "$DEST_ORG_ID" \
 --out ./terraform/

Check: ./terraform/ holds versions.tf, providers.tf, contexts.tf, projects.tf, migration.auto.tfvars.json and GAPS.md.

Other files appear when they apply: restrictions.tf, webhooks.tf, runners.tf, pipelines.tf (GitHub App and standalone destinations only), secrets.auto.tfvars.json and imports.tf.

Pick the destination type

The provider supports advanced project settings only on GitHub App and standalone orgs. On a GitHub OAuth org they would make terraform apply fail.

--dest-org-type Aliases Use for
oauth gh, github gh/<org> destination. Advanced settings, pipelines and triggers are left to sync.
standalone app, github_app circleci/<id> destination. Everything is included.

If you omit it, the type is inferred from the source slug in the manifest, and a note prints which type was assumed.

Secret values

The manifest has no secret values. Choose one:

# Plaintext values from a captured bundle, written to secrets.auto.tfvars.json
circleci-migrate terraform generate --manifest manifest.json --secrets secrets.json \
 --dest-org-id "$DEST_ORG_ID" --out ./terraform/

# REPLACE_ME values plus a SECRETS_WORKBOOK.md to fill in
circleci-migrate terraform generate --manifest manifest.json --placeholders \
 --dest-org-id "$DEST_ORG_ID" --out ./terraform/

Warning

--secrets writes plaintext. Treat secrets.auto.tfvars.json like a password file and delete it after terraform apply.

Apply, then fill the gaps 

cd ./terraform/
export TF_VAR_circleci_api_token="<destination-org-admin-token>"
terraform init && terraform plan && terraform apply
cd ..
circleci-migrate sync --manifest manifest.json --mapping mapping.json --apply --skip-terraform-managed

Check: terraform plan shows the resource counts you expect, and a second plan shows no changes.

--skip-terraform-managed skips contexts, projects and runner classes, which Terraform now owns. To choose sections yourself, use --only with org-settings, ciam, extras, contexts, projects, runner or orb. The two flags are mutually exclusive.

Adopt resources sync already created

Capture their IDs with sync --json, then emit Terraform import blocks (Terraform 1.5 or later) into imports.tf:

circleci-migrate sync --manifest manifest.json --mapping mapping.json --json > sync-result.json
circleci-migrate terraform generate --manifest manifest.json --dest-org-id "$DEST_ORG_ID" \
 --import-existing --existing sync-result.json --out ./terraform/

Other options

  • --mapping mapping.json remaps org slugs and project IDs, the same file sync uses.
  • --dest-runner-namespace maps runner classes to a different namespace. By default the source namespace is kept.
  • --host sets the provider host for CircleCI Server.

What Terraform does not manage

These always need sync and appear in GAPS.md: legacy schedules, checkout and deploy keys, additional SSH keys, project API tokens, roles and groups, org settings (feature flags, OIDC, OTel, contacts, retention, budgets, orb allow list, SSO, release tracker), and private orb inlining.

For an OAuth destination, project advanced settings and pipeline and trigger resources also go to sync.
